hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); for p in .env .env.local secrets/ .git/ credentials package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml; do if [[ "$FILE" == *"$p"* ]]; then echo "Blocked: $FILE matches protected pattern $p" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command" <<< "$(cat)"); for p in "rm -rf /$" "rm -rf ~$" "rm -rf \\.$" "drop table" "DROP TABLE" "truncate table" "TRUNCATE TABLE" "git push.*--force" "git reset --hard"; do if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "$p"; then echo "Blocked: destructive pattern \"$p\" detected in: $CMD" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; exit 0'
